title: On Packing the chest in one evening
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：pack　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pack 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the painter ① packed the chest in one evening in public, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② packs the chest in one evening in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pack the chest in one evening at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ packed the chest in one evening before — a line in the catalogue for May 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Packing the chest in one evening in public, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pack the front hall with boxes in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pack the front hall with boxes at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ packs the front hall with boxes in public every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ packed the chest in one evening again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pack the chest in one evening, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody packs the chest in one evening in silence again and somebody must pack the chest in one evening in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 收拾（一般过去式 packed the chest in one evening：1953 年画师头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 收拾（一般现在 packs the chest in one evening：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 收拾（不定式 to pack the chest in one evening：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 收拾（过去完成时 had packed the chest in one evening：1947 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 收拾（动名词 packing the chest in one evening 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 塞满（pack the front hall with boxes：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去塞满让箱子把前厅塞得满满）
G. v. 塞满（pack the front hall with boxes：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 收拾（后段两处：新来的观者照例 packs the front hall with boxes，而母亲又一次 packed the chest in one evening）

answers.why: pack 意为“收拾”，1953 年画师当着众人面收拾一个傍晚就把箱子收拾好，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 packed。
pack 意为“收拾”，自那以后画师一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 packs。
pack 意为“收拾”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯收拾一个傍晚就把箱子收拾好”，此处为不定式 to pack the chest in one evening。
pack 意为“收拾”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人收拾过，故用过去完成时 had packed。
pack 意为“收拾”，画师说“收拾一个傍晚就把箱子收拾好这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 packing the chest in one evening 作主语。
pack 意为“塞满”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去塞满让箱子把前厅塞得满满”，should ever 之后用原形 pack the front hall with boxes。
pack 意为“塞满”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻塞满让箱子把前厅塞得满满（pack the front hall with boxes at once），以后再也不要提起。
pack 意为“收拾”，新来的观者每个季度都照例塞满让箱子把前厅塞得满满，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 packs。
pack 意为“收拾”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面收拾一个傍晚就把箱子收拾好，用一般过去式 packed 叙述。
pack 意为“收拾”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要收拾一个傍晚就把箱子收拾好，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pack 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the painter packed the chest in one evening in public, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter packs the chest in one evening in silence whenever the studio asks.
Packing the chest in one evening in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pack the front hall with boxes in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio packs the front hall with boxes in public every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother packed the chest in one evening again, and the studio remembered that half.
